_note: The Lost (2026-11-17): garments as their own meshes for Unity Cloth (the user: 'separate the armor or cloth only, not the limbs. and give it realistic physics'). Boxes are concept pixels (1024x1024).

parts.name: garment
parts.keep: the whole rusted studded leather tunic from the shoulders down to its hem, the wide belt with its bronze buckle and the cross strap, without the fur mantle, as a garment on its own: no body, no head, no arms, no hands, no legs, the garment hollow inside where the body was, seen straight from the front

parts.name: helm
parts.keep: the rusted iron spectacle helm with its round eye guards and hanging mail curtain, as an object on its own: no head, no face, the helmet hollow inside where the head was, seen straight from the front
